result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY persist/replay adversarial re-verify of G6-001 M1+M2 evidence. Independent re-runs: python services/world_authority_poc/run_poc_tests.py → 19/19 OK, G6_WORLD_AUTHORITY_SMOKE=PASS; Godot g6_two_client_smoke.gd → G6_TWO_CLIENT_SMOKE=PASS checks=12. Six challenge invariants all PASS against executable evidence and product code (read-only): (1) duplicate request_id same payload → idempotent_replay same receipt, no second entity/revision/outbox; (2) same key changed payload → rejected policy idempotency payload mismatch, no mutation; (3) stale expected_world_revision → conflicted revision_mismatch, head unchanged; (4) reconnect/replay converges without double application; (5) entity_set_hash stable after commit (re-query + idempotent replay preserve hash); (6) forged attempts leave revision+entity_set_hash unchanged. Residual for M4: M2 smoke does not executable-cover TM-IDEMPOTENT-REPLAY / TM-IDEMPOTENCY-PAYLOAD-CONFLICT / TM-STALE-REVISION (GDScript paths present; M1 matrix is sole executable cover). No product edits; no children; self_accept=false; next_route M4_CORE_TWO_CLIENT_PURPLE.
